source.name: Escape must close the dropdown menu and return focus to its toggle button

journey.title: Close the invoice actions menu with Escape
journey.goal: Escape closes the menu and focus returns to the toggle

functionalJourney.title: Archive the invoice from the actions menu
functionalJourney.goal: The chosen action runs and the menu closes

guards.title: Choose an action with the keyboard
guards.goal: Arrow keys move through items and Enter runs one

plan.root_cause: Escape keydown on a menu item triggers the dropdown hide method, but focus is not returned to the toggle after hiding. When the menu loses the .show class (display:none), the focused menu item becomes hidden and the browser shifts focus to the body, causing the focus assertion to fail.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the Dropdown.hide() method to restore focus to the toggle button (this._element) after completing the hide operation, ensuring focus returns to the activator when the dropdown is closed via Escape.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Escape while the actions menu is open will close the menu and move focus back to the 'Invoice actions' toggle button, meeting keyboard accessibility requirements for dropdown menus.
functional_risks: Focus may be restored to the toggle when the dropdown is dismissed by clicking outside or selecting a menu item, which could shift focus unexpectedly for some users.
If the toggle button is disabled or detached at the time of hide, the focus call will be safely ignored by the browser.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Escape with focus on any menu item results in aria-expanded='false' on the toggle and focus returning to the toggle.
Verify that clicking outside the menu or selecting a menu item still closes the menu and does not cause JavaScript errors.
Verify that the dropdown can still be opened via ArrowDown or click and that focus initially moves to the first menu item as before.
